sloka: सर्वे च विदुषो वीराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।सर्वे प्रवरविज्ञानाः सर्वे लब्धवरास्तथा ।। ६.६९.१३ ।।
transliteration: sarve ca viduṣo vīrāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ।sarve pravaravijñānāḥ sarve labdhavarāstathā ।। 6.69.13 ।।

translations.english: All were experts in the use of weapons, all were heroes and skilled in warfare, knowledgeable in scriptures, so also all were blessed with boons.
